title: ruehssia clausa
intro: Ruehssia clausa, commonly known as Chinese goldenseal, is a plant species that belongs to the Berberidaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ruehssia clausa include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, making it effective against bacterial and viral infections. The bioactive constituents of Ruehssia clausa include alkaloids, such as berberine, which contributes to its medicinal properties.
